def f(grid, fill=2):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sp=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg][0]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(1,w-1):
            if grid[r][c]==bg and grid[r][c-1]==sp and grid[r][c+1]==sp:
                out[r][c]=fill
    return out
